propositions: terraform-drift.yml workflow does not trigger on Gerrit changes, only on GitHub pull_request and push events, so unapplied terraform lands with passing Verified gate
post-merge terraform plan fails after change submission reveals infrastructure was committed but never applied
commit e9d4d390c3 added CloudWatch alarm resource to HCL that existed nowhere in AWS, demonstrating the gap between code review and infrastructure reality
current process allows a reviewer to conclude from green Verified +1 that terraform infrastructure is live, but this is incorrect because the drift check runs after submit
manual terraform apply step is undocumented folklore with no runbook requirement or commit-message attestation, leaving no record that apply is mandatory before landing is complete
